title: Flow Cytometry to Quantify tdTomato+ mDANs
author: Ellen Hertz

steps.title: Wash cells with DPBS
steps.instruction: Wash the mDANs once with DPBS.

steps.title: Triturate cells in Neurobasal
steps.instruction: Using a 1 mL pipette tip, triturate the mDANs in Neurobasal medium containing 10 % fetal bovine serum to achieve dissociation.

steps.title: Resuspend cells with inhibitors
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dissociated mDANs in Neurobasal medium with 10 % fetal bovine serum, add 10 µM Y‑27632 and 5 µM Emricasan, and adjust to a concentration of 1 × 10⁶ cells per mL.

steps.title: Enzymatic dissociation with papain
steps.instruction: Incubate Day 35 mDNAs in pre‑warmed papain solution containing DNAse, Y‑27632 and Emricasan for 00:10:00 at 37 °C (iPSCs can be used as the negative control).

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pellet the mDANs by centrifugation at 400 × g, °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Define tdTomato‑ negative control
steps.instruction: Run iPSCs through the cytometer to define the tdTomato‑ population and set the fluorescence threshold for identifying tdTomato⁺ cells in the mDAN suspension.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension and keep cold
steps.instruction: Pass the mDAN suspension through a strainer tube, collect the filtrate, and keep the filtered cells on ice until analysis.
